description: List the posable skeleton of one character: every FK bone and every IK target, with the names studio_set_character_bone and studio_set_character_ik expect. Which bones exist depends on the character's rig, hair and clothes (roughly 135 on a male, 150 on a female), so call this before posing rather than guessing bone names. Bone names are the rig's own transform names ('cf_J_ArmUp00_L', 'cf_J_Hand_Thumb01_R') and are unique per character; 'label' is Studio's Japanese caption and is shared by several bones, so never use it as a key.

mode.description: the chain currently driving the skeleton; 'bones' can only be written while this is 'fk', 'ik_targets' only while it is 'ik'

bones.description: FK bones, rotation only — Studio gives bone guides no position or scale handle

bone.description: the name to pass to studio_set_character_bone, e.g. 'cf_J_ArmLow01_L'

label.description: Studio's caption, in Japanese and not unique — display only

group.description: the FK group this bone answers to; it must be on in studio_set_character_kinematics before the bone can be posed

weighted.description: the bone drives mesh vertices on the character's current clothes. **false means posing it does nothing** — FK skips unweighted bones, which is the normal state of the 48 skirt bones when no skirt is worn

rot.description: current local euler angles, degrees; round-trips into studio_set_character_bone

ik_targets.description: the 13 IK targets, always present in this order

target.description: the name to pass to studio_set_character_ik; the '_chain' targets are the elbow/knee poles that steer where the joint bends

group.description: the IK group this target answers to; it must be on in studio_set_character_kinematics before the target can be moved

bone.description: the rig bone this target steers

rotatable.description: the target has a rotation handle. Only the four hand and foot targets do; studio_set_character_ik rejects 'rot' on the others

pos.description: current offset from the target's rest position, in scene units

rot.description: current euler angles, degrees; always [0,0,0] when 'rotatable' is false
